title.full: Using the title Dr in healthcare advertising

summary.text: Yes, but they must state their qualifications and say they do not hold a valid practising certificate.

details.heading: What the advertisement must include
details.body: They must state their qualifications and include a disclaimer saying they do not hold a valid practising certificate issued by the relevant local healthcare professional board.

details.heading: Who this applies to
details.body: This applies when these doctors or dentists are featured in advertisements for healthcare services.

example_phrasings: Can an unregistered doctor use Dr?
Can overseas-trained doctors use Dr in ads?
Can retired dentists use Dr in advertising?

sources.page_title: Can overseas-trained or retired doctors and dentists who are not registered in Singapore use the title “Dr” in healthcare service advertising?

quotes.text: Overseas-trained or retired doctors/dentists who are not registered in Singapore and do not hold a valid practising certificate, must comply with the following when using the title “Dr” in their healthcare service advertising:
This advertising control would apply when any of these doctors/dentists are featured in advertisements of healthcare services
